iut_type: End Product (IDEAL company; third-party payment scenario)
customer_question: If our company's registration fee payment is actually wired by a different company on our behalf, who ends up holding the Qualification Number, and how does the Invoice process work in that case?
question_variants: Can a third party pay our SIG registration fee, and does the Qualification Number still go to us?
How do we get the Invoice if a different company will actually wire the funds?
actual_issue: The customer needed clarity on the Invoice/payment mechanics when the actual wire transfer would be executed by a different company than the one registering, to confirm the Qualification Number would still be correctly assigned.
plain_english_explanation: The Invoice must always be generated by the registering company's own SIG account holder login — it cannot be generated by the paying third party. If a different company (Company B) will actually wire the funds on behalf of the registering company (Company A), Company A's account holder must still obtain the Invoice themselves and forward it to Company B, who then executes the wire transfer. Regardless of who actually pays, the Qualification Number is always assigned to whichever company's account generated the Invoice — in this case, Company A.
consultant_answer: The Invoice must be generated using the registering company's (Company A's) own SIG account login, even if Company B will be the one actually wiring the funds. Company A obtains the Invoice and forwards it to Company B for payment. The Qualification Number will still be assigned to Company A, since it is tied to whichever account generated the Invoice, not to whoever actually pays.
decision_logic: Qualification Number assignment follows Invoice-generation account ownership, not payment execution; third-party payment does not transfer or alter this assignment as long as the registering company's own account is used to obtain the Invoice.
final_recommendation: When a customer mentions a different entity will handle actual payment, proactively clarify the Invoice-generation/Qualification-Number assignment rule to prevent confusion about registration ownership.
risk_if_done_wrong: If the paying company mistakenly generates the Invoice using its own account, the Qualification Number would be misassigned to the wrong company.
